scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained; finite checker corroborates but does not prove all-q assertion. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary q-ary cyclic four-letter palindromes only; covers at least once; no count of all minimizers, no linear result for general q; q=2 value known in an existing linear OEIS table; shared skeleton bound with an earlier length-three theorem; remaining priority uncertainty in unindexed literature.
title: Sharp cyclic covers of all length-four palindromes
